name: Theron
description: Theron was a planet in the Theron system in the Vilonis sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square O-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid, whose surface featured famous spiral stone formations. It had a strong racing culture, including podracing and the Five Sabers tournament.
